t: Titan TTB879GRD 2000W 9" electric angle grinder is a robust and powerful tool designed for demanding cutting and grinding tasks. 230mm blade diameter and 6500rpm no-load speed provide efficient material removal, ideal for use in metal fabrication, masonry work, and construction projects. The compact 240V angle grinder features an aluminium gearbox housing for durability, and a fan-cooled motor to prevent overheating during prolonged use. Rear-handle grip offers enhanced control and user comfort, while dust-sealed bearings extend the tool's lifespan in harsh workshop environments. Replaceable carbon brushes and external brush doors simplify maintenance, ensuring consistent performance for trade professionals. Supplied with cutting and grinding guards.
